description: FAMILY PATHWAYS: who can come with, or join, the main applicant — spouse, unmarried/same-sex partner, children (MAXIMUM AGE and when age is measured), adult dependent children, parents, siblings — whether they join at the SAME TIME or LATER, what happens if a child ages out, and every related cost by dependant category. Three modes. (1) programme_id: dependants record of one investment-migration programme, e.g. antigua-cbi, greece-gv. (2) cc: family-reunification law of a country by sponsor class (citizen, resident, investor-visa holder): relatives, waiting period, income and housing tests, fees, processing time. (3) screen: pass children_ages (e.g. [7,15,24]) plus optional parents, partner, together_required to rank programmes that can include the WHOLE family, per person. Each figure carries legal basis, source tier and date. Absence means UNVERIFIED, never that no route exists. Information, not legal advice.

cc.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 of the country whose family-reunification law you need, e.g. PT, AE, US

children_ages.description: Ages of the children (completed years) for screen mode, e.g. [7,15,24]

parents.description: Screen mode: parents must be includable

partner.description: Screen mode: include an unmarried partner who is not a spouse

programme_id.description: A programme id from list_programmes, e.g. antigua-cbi

sponsor.description: Filter the cc routes by sponsor class: citizen, permanent_resident, temporary_resident, investor_visa_holder, worker, student

together_required.description: Screen mode: everyone must be includable in the SAME application (no later add-on)

type.description: Screen mode: limit to citizenship or residence programmes
